- D2 glossary/species.json holds every species name the bank uses, each surface form (singular and plural) its own entry, plus every species of Portaria 67/2024 (diariodarepublica.pt/dr/detalhe/portaria/67-2024-853384722). group is the manifest topic slug when the species' family has one (patos for every duck, tordos for every thrush, pombos-rolas for pigeons and doves), nao-cinegeticas for a protected species, outras-cinegeticas for a game species with no topic (corvids, starling, geese). - D4 Register is literal-leaning: keep the Portuguese order and structure where English allows, British spelling (licence, metres, colour), numbers, units and times as the Portuguese has them, a bare number or proper name copied unchanged. Reason: the peek unblocks a word in the sentence being read; it is not a reading mode (DESIGN.md § 6, § 9 peek decision).
